> ThriveTools is a wellness and biohacking resource by Eden Laraki. The site covers evidence-based longevity, plant medicine, breathwork, psychedelic-assisted healing, and curated product reviews.

- [Blog & Articles](https://thrivetools.co/blog) — science-backed guides on biohacking, supplements, plant medicine, and longevity

- [Personalized Guidance](https://thrivetools.co/personalized-guidance) — 1-on-1 biohacking and wellness consulting with Eden
